                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Zhangshujun/p/23523188" title="发布于 2026-11-02 15:42">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2"># [CSP-S 2026] 迁徙 / migrate 题解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="思路">思路</h2>
<p>首先考虑暴力dp，考虑 <span class="math inline">\(f_i\)</span> 为从点 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 到右边点最短路的方案，<span class="math inline">\(\operatorname{dist}(i,j)\)</span> 为点 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 到点 <span class="math inline">\(j\)</span> 的最短距离，那么有，枚举左端点 <span class="math inline">\(l\)</span>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\Large{f_i=\sum_{x_j + d \ge x_i且\operatorname{dist}(l,j) + 1 = \operatorname{dist}(l,i)}f_j}
\]</div><p></p><p>时间复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(\Theta(n^3)\)</span></p>
<p>考虑如何优化。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\operatorname{dist}(l,i)\)</span> 会把整个序列分成很多层，由于最短路一定是贪心的往更右边走，所以一层的转移只和上一层的最后三个有关，我们考虑当前一层的最后三个数的方案数分别为 <span class="math inline">\(x,y,z\)</span> 。考虑记忆化搜索，但状态太多，记不下来</p>
<p>考虑转移过程。当 <span class="math inline">\(z = 2\)</span> 时，只能从<span class="math inline">\(z\)</span> 转移，否则当  <span class="math inline">\(z = 1,y = 1\)</span> 就能从<span class="math inline">\(x, y\)</span> 转移，否则无法转移。</p>
<p>于是可以把 <span class="math inline">\(z &gt; 2,y&gt;1,x&gt;0\)</span> 分别压成一种状态，就装的下了。</p>
<p>答案为 <span class="math inline">\(\sum_{i = 1}^n \operatorname{dfs}(i,0,0,1)\)</span></p>
<p>时间复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(\Theta(n)\)</span>。</p>
<h2 id="code">Code：</h2>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\text{C++Code:}\)</span></p>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
#define int long long
using namespace std;
constexpr int MAXN = 2e6 + 5;
int f[MAXN][2][3][4];
int x[MAXN];
int nxt[MAXN];
int n, d;
int dfs(int cur, int x, int y, int z) {
	if (cur == n || !z || z &gt; 2) return 0 ;
	if (~f[cur][x][y][z]) return f[cur][x][y][z];  
	int res = 0;
	int pos_x = x ? nxt[cur - 2] : cur,
		pos_y = y ? nxt[cur - 1] : cur,
		pos_z = z ? nxt[cur] : cur;
	int nxt_pos = nxt[cur];
	int nxt_x = 0, nxt_y = 0, nxt_z = 0;
	if (nxt_pos &gt; cur) {
		nxt_z = z;
		if (pos_y &gt;= nxt_pos) nxt_z += y;
		if (pos_x &gt;= nxt_pos) nxt_z += x;
	}
	if (nxt_pos - 1 &gt; cur) {
		nxt_y = z;
		if (pos_y &gt;= nxt_pos - 1) nxt_y += y;
		if (pos_x &gt;= nxt_pos - 1) nxt_y += x;
	}
	if (nxt_pos - 2 &gt; cur) {
		nxt_x = z;
		if (pos_y &gt;= nxt_pos - 2) nxt_x += y;
		if (pos_x &gt;= nxt_pos - 2) nxt_x += x;
	} 
	if (z == 2) 
		res += pos_z - pos_y;
	else if (y == 1)
		res += pos_y - pos_x;
  
	res += dfs(nxt_pos, min(1ll, nxt_x), min(2ll, nxt_y), min(3ll, nxt_z));
	return f[cur][x][y][z] = res;
}
void solve() {
	cin &gt;&gt; n &gt;&gt; d;
	for (int i = 1; i &lt;= n; ++i) 
		cin &gt;&gt; x[i];
	for (int l = 1, r = 1; l &lt;= n; ++l) {
		while (r &lt; n &amp;&amp; x[l] + d &gt;= x[r + 1]) ++r;
		nxt[l] = r;
	}
//	for (int i = 1; i &lt;= n; ++i)
//		cerr &lt;&lt; nxt[i] &lt;&lt; ' ';
//	cerr &lt;&lt; '\n';
	int ans = 0;
	for (int i = 1; i &lt;= n; ++i)
		for (int j = 0; j &lt; 2; ++j)
			for (int k = 0; k &lt; 3; ++k)
				for (int l = 0; l &lt; 4; ++l)
					f[i][j][k][l] = -1;
	for (int i = 1; i &lt;= n; ++i)
		ans += dfs(i, 0, 0, 1);
	cout &lt;&lt; ans &lt;&lt; '\n';
}
signed main() {
#ifndef DEBUG
	ios::sync_with_stdio(0), cin.tie(0), cout.tie(0);
	freopen("migrate.in", "r", stdin);
	freopen("migrate.out", "w", stdout);
#else
#endif
	int c, T;
	cin &gt;&gt; c &gt;&gt; T;
	while(T--) solve();
	return 0;
} 
</code></pre>
